item_short_desc: Rothco's Multi-Colored Paracord Bracelet is a versatile and essential accessory for any outdoor enthusiast and survivalist. Made from strong and durable 7-strand polyester paracord, this outdoor bracelet is designed to provide reliable performance in various survival situations. The paracord can be unraveled when needed, offering you approximately 7 feet of high-tensile strength cordage that can be used for a multitude of tasks such as building shelters, securing gear, or even as an emergency tourniquet.
description: Rothco's Multi-Colored Paracord Bracelet is a versatile and essential accessory for any outdoor enthusiast and survivalist. Made from strong and durable 7-strand polyester paracord, this outdoor bracelet is designed to provide reliable performance in various survival situations. The paracord can be unraveled when needed, offering you approximately 7 feet of high-tensile strength cordage that can be used for a multitude of tasks such as building shelters, securing gear, or even as an emergency tourniquet. The quick-release side buckle ensures that the bracelet is easy to put on and take off, while also providing a secure closure that won't accidentally come undone. The multi-colored design adds a touch of style, making it not only a practical survival tool but also rugged accessory for everyday wear. Whether you're hiking, camping, or simply exploring the great outdoors, Rothco's Paracord Bracelet is a must-have item that combines functionality, durability, and style in one compact package.
